note: Invented reports for a demo. Written before Decima v1.1 existed and kept fixed; every decision shown is computed live.

service.text: Which service should respond to this report?

criteria.fire: Fire, smoke, gas leak, explosion or people trapped
criteria.police: Crime, violence, theft, threats or suspicious activity
criteria.medical: Someone is ill, injured or unconscious and needs an ambulance
criteria.traffic: Road collision without injuries, blocked road or broken traffic lights
criteria.utilities: Power outage, water main break or fallen power lines
criteria.city_services: Non-urgent city issues: potholes, noise, trash, streetlights, stray animals

levels: Low: no danger, can wait a few days
High: needs a response within the hour

danger.text: A person may be hurt or in immediate danger.
